To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) PFp neurons were selectively active for the goal chosen at feedback time; 2) PFp neurons encoded the selected goal throughout the trial; 3) PFp cells had a lower Fano factor than non-goal cells; and 4) PFp cells with a low Fano factor were also more goal-selective.
